full_judgment: 2. Sabitri Sundari Mali predecessor of the appellants filed Preemption Case No. 18 of 1994 in the Court of the Subordinate Judge, 1st Court, Munshiganj, under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act for pre-emption of the land transferred by the respondent Nos. 3-7 by kabala dated 18.11.1993 to the respondent Nos. 1 and 2. The case of the pre-emptor originally was that she was the co-sharer in jote and that the purchaser-respondent Nos. 1 and 2 were stranger to that.
